title: Read-only SDK calls for ZPA triage

prose.text: Read-only calls can list the rules that reference a segment and look up posture profiles and connectors.

prose.label: Connectors.
prose.text: {{python-groups-summary}} {{no-connection-state-field}} The sourced connector fields are in [[zpa.app-connectors.health]].

checks.do: Which policy rules reference the application segment, with the application ID and the policy type.
Whether a posture UDID in a policy operand resolves to a profile, remembering that a miss is returned as an error.
Which connector field carries the control connection state, since no connection_state field exists.
What the connector groups summary call returns before relying on it for counts or windows.

go-policy-by-application.statement: The Go SDK's policysetcontrollerv2.GetPolicyByApplication, given a policy type and an application ID, calls GET .../policySet/rules/policyType/{type}/application/{id} and returns the policy rules for that application.

quotes: func GetPolicyByApplication(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, policyType string, applicationID string) ([]PolicyRuleResource, *http.Response, error) {

go-application-mappings.statement: The Go SDK's applicationsegment.GetApplicationMappings calls GET .../application/{id}/mappings and returns name and type pairs for the objects mapped to the segment.

quotes: type ApplicationMappings struct { Name string `json:"name,omitempty"` Type string `json:"type,omitempty"` }

go-posture-by-udid.statement: The Go SDK's postureprofile.GetByPostureUDID lists the posture profiles and returns the one whose postureUDID matches, and when none matches it returns a nil profile with the error 'no posture profile with postureUDID ... was found'.

quotes: return nil, resp, fmt.Errorf("no posture profile with postureUDID '%s' was found", postureUDID)

python-groups-summary.statement: The Python SDK's list_connector_groups_summary is documented as retrieving all configured App Connector groups' names and IDs.

quotes: Retrieves all configured app connector groups Name and IDs

no-connection-state-field.statement: Neither SDK models a connection_state or ConnectionState field on an App Connector: the control connection state is controlChannelStatus.

quotes: self.control_channel_status = config["controlChannelStatus"] if "controlChannelStatus" in config else None

no-connection-state-field.conditions: Absence claim. A search of the ZPA packages of the Go and Python SDKs, of the Terraform provider and of the ZPA OpenAPI document found no field named connection_state, connectionState or ConnectionState.
